key_id.description: sha256 digest of the raw 32-byte public key.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64 (44 chars incl. padding).

signature.description: 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the ASCII bytes of the capsule id, base64.

signer.description: Optional identity claim; binding is established by the key published on this profile (author.sig) or the provider key registry (receipt.sig).
